title: Ordinary test recording: finish visible command-shape and discovered-run diagnostics
outcome: A standard detached full gate run by a gated Engram-project session under a live claim either produces a host verification record bound to the claim, or a typed, visible refusal stating why. It never produces silence.
acceptance: A cause note with evidence identifies why test-878d6a11 produced neither a verification record nor a refusal: recognition, binding/grant, carried-check settlement, or reset aftermath. Where the cause is in source, the note gives file:line.

Deterministic tests show that a detached full gate by a gated-project session under a live claim yields either a bound verification record or a typed visible refusal, including immediately after a project settings reset.
